READING THE ROYAL ATLAS
🔍One banner per patch of land — the biggest title that holds it. Zoom in and it opens: kingdoms & duchies → counties → towns → villages
🧭You — your blue beacon, always pulsing
🕊️A village you freed — tap to visit & govern
🏘️Town / City — neighbouring villages grown together
🛡️County banner — 3+ freed villages united
👑Duchy / Kingdom banner — counties sworn as one. It stands alone until you zoom in on it
⚔️A dark village near you, waiting to be freed
💀LV on a dark banner — the garrison's recommended level. Green suits your flock; red means come back stronger. Every liberation raises the world level, and the far frontier always fights hardest
〰️Gold arc — a trade route between your counties
🎨Painted lands — counties sworn to one duchy or kingdom share its colour
Daylight on the map = lands you have freed. Darkness = lands still waiting.
